n1.speaker: narrator
n1.text: Your cot. A note on the pillow: 'Lights out at ten. Rise at six. - The Bursar'

zz_m.speaker: narrator
zz_m.text: You sleep the dreamless sleep of the filed. The morning bell wakes you, mended.

zz_n.speaker: narrator
zz_n.text: You doze until the night bell. The corridors empty. Somewhere, a cabinet waits to be moved.
